newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran close to awarding Balal oilfield project.
newsitem.headline: Iran close to awarding Balal oilfield project.

text.p: Iran is close to awarding foreign firms a contract to develop its Balal offshore oilfield under its buy-back formula issued in 1995, a senior Iranian oil official said on Wednesday.
"The bidders, who have offered favourable technical and commercial proposals, have already been selected," Esmaeil Jalilian, offshore director at the National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC), said.
"The awarded bidder will soon be determined and the contract will be signed," he said in a statement sent to Reuters.
Successful foreign bidders could fall foul of the U.S. sanctions aimed at deterring investment in Iran's oil and gas sector.
Balal oilfield in the Gulf has no production history but is scheduled to produce 40,000 barrels per day (bpd) by the end of the decade.
